slides.name: hook
slides.head:
उसकी शादी में खुश भी थी।
और थोड़ा अकेली भी।
slides.sub: You can be happy for her and still feel it.

slides.name: card
slides.title: Three of Cups
slides.sub: The card of friends celebrating together.

slides.name: cups
slides.label: LOOK CLOSER
slides.head: One cup is higher.
slides.sub:
The other two are still raising theirs.
Her happiness takes nothing from yours.

slides.name: message
slides.line:
Charu से पूछो, ताकि तुम्हें पता हो।
बस अपने लिये।
